_help: Source for the Parlays tab. One entry per slip. 'by' is Big Goat or Lil Goat; 'played' marks the slip that was actually bet. status: pending, won or lost. Leg 'r' is won/lost when known; leave it out if not. 'mult' is the approximate payout multiple from the leg prices (before Kalshi's combo pricing); 'payout' is the real amount once settled. Runs track the 2x challenge bankroll.
